title: Starter: Scene Still
summary: A neutral still scene to copy: a plain sky over flat ground with placeholder shapes (a grey box with a marker, two flat blocks, a foreground strip), rendered once by a small Python program. It draws no subject of its own; its one frame passes the lofi frame gate.
request: No user request: a new starter planned in docs/PLAN-library.md section 6.2 (`starter-scene-still`, script runtime, status starter): an empty piece for the scene mode that renders a still and passes the gate empty.
